No data exfiltration, unexpected network access, or dangerous runtime modifications are present.

The package installs only the intended binary, documentation, and license, placing them in standard system directories. Optional dependencies are clearly declared and relate to the application's alarm functionality. No system-wide configuration changes or privileged operations are performed. The package does not include or execute code from external or untrusted sources.
